notes: Every row is read from a primary source and carries that row's own source_url and retrieved_at.
A row whose retrieved_at is older than stale_after_days is reported as STALE by kcheck; it is never silently reused as if fresh.
Only verified distro rows are present. A distro with no row is UNMEASURABLE (exit 2), never 'patched'.
fix_state: pending = the vendor confirms the range and has not released a fix yet; released = fixed_version exists and is comparable; not_affected = the vendor marks the release unaffected.
No network, no feed client: updating this file is a deliberate, dated act.

cves.title: Linux IPv4 TCP use-after-free on the MPTCP path (remote, unauthenticated)

attack_path.label: MPTCP listener reachable from a remote peer (PoC reached root with no credentials)

mitigation.summary: operator-side only: an nftables u32 rule dropping TCP segments with header options, or disabling net.mptcp.enabled in /etc/sysctl.d; neither fixes the kernel and both last until reboot

ubuntu-26.04.status_text: 26.04 LTS resolute | Vulnerable | work in progress in 7.0.0-43.43
ubuntu-26.04.note: The tracker names 7.0.0-43.43 as the target and marks it work in progress; that version is NOT released, so there is nothing to compare against and the host cannot be patched yet.
